{{Top|leg}}
'''Jonex''' was a small [[Mining/Legends|mining]] corporation that established a number of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] in the [[MZX32905 system/Legends|MZX32905 system]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> One of the mines the corporation established centuries before the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> was the [[Jonex Mine Eight Eleven B]]<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> deep beneath the surface of [[The Home]], a large [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the MZX32905 system.<ref name="Betrayal" /> Jonex was still in operation in the years following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
